verdict.text: Nothing worth lining up for this morning (Thu Nov 26). Evidence: zero posts in either server report anyone lining up, waiting, or expecting a drop on Thursday, and no wristband/ticket intel for Thursday. All 7+ independent mentions point to Friday Nov 27 instead — Costco in-transit AH Mini Tins may be put out Friday (unconfirmed speculation), Best Buy Friday TCG stock looks low, Pop Plug Santa Clara 7 AM raffle Friday. Wednesday's Costco AH tin drop sold out by late morning at most stores; Vallejo lasted longest. One Piece OP18 still had a lot at San Jose Bandai Wed afternoon, limit 6 — no line needed.
